lessons.title: IAM in one sentence
lessons.summary: IAM is a way of preserving coherent identity while intentions move through changing tools, contexts, and forms of action.

lessons.title: Power has boundaries
lessons.summary: An IAM-aligned system does not assume unlimited access. Capabilities are granted explicitly, kept proportionate, and made reviewable.

lessons.title: Meaning and evidence have different jobs
lessons.summary: Mythic language can help people interpret purpose and values. Evidence, policy, contracts, and explicit permission govern factual and operational claims.

lessons.title: Build relationships before complexity
lessons.summary: Complex systems become understandable when their parts, inputs, outputs, and transformations remain visible.

lessons.title: A practical reading of IAM
lessons.summary: IAM joins identity, bounded agency, visible relationships, stewardship, and optional mythic interpretation into one public teaching frame.

lessons.title: Agency is authorship inside boundaries
lessons.summary: Agency means having meaningful influence over framing, alternatives, challenge paths, and action while consent, permission, evidence, safety, and rights still set limits.

lessons.title: Readiness needs evidence and review
lessons.summary: Creating a change does not make it ready. Validation, independent review, resolved objections, explicit authorization, and recovery paths support trustworthy promotion.

lessons.title: Relationship gives context, not control
lessons.summary: Context and relationship can shape meaning without overriding agency, privacy, dissent, or the right to revise an interpretation. Silence may protect uncertainty, but not conceal material risk.

lessons.title: Commitment stays accountable
lessons.summary: A promise does not create authority by itself. Consequential commitments should remain attributable, challengeable, amendable, consent-aware, and responsible for repair and governed release.

lessons.title: IAM is a governed ecology, not one all-knowing mind
lessons.summary: IAM coordinates bounded specialist responsibilities through explicit dependencies, evidence, permission, review, and publication discipline. Personas are roles or lenses, not sovereign minds or privileged truth sources.
